title: Microsoft Clipchamp: New text and shape animations in the video editor
description: Clipchamp Editor will support simple animations for text layers. Users can apply preset in/out animations, adjust how long the animation lasts, choose its direction, and preview the animated text in the editor prior to exporting. This capability will be available across web and native desktop versions of Clipchamp.
